Valid, fixed in the latest push. A Retry click carries no attachments of its own: protobuf decodes the omitted `images` field as `[]`, so `images ?? retry.images` kept the empty list. The retry now uses `images?.length ? images : retry.images`, so the failed start's attachments go to the retried sandbox unless the response actually carries some. Covered by `keeps the original attachments when Retry arrives with the webview's empty image list` in `SdkController.test.ts`, which sends Retry with `[]` and fails without the fix.

The same push merges `main` into this branch (the only conflict was in `state-keys.ts`, where `main` removed the focus-chain setting next to the new cloud keys). On the merged result, the full extension type check, vitest (1,452), `test:cloud` (23), the bun unit tests and the webview tests (584) all pass.

This used to resolve local-CLI status from the provider registry; it now requires matching `providerAuth`. When those facts are absent or don't match the selected provider it silently becomes "not a local-CLI provider" — a `claude-code` user gets "Check your model connection in Settings → API Providers" rather than "Sign in again with the `claude` CLI". `resolveCredentialFailureAction` at line 291 has the same gate and returns an "Open API providers" action instead of `null`.

The live paths try to keep these facts synchronized, so the happy path is covered — it's the fallback that changed. Preserving built-in auth behaviour when catalog facts aren't available, or making "unknown auth" an explicit state rather than a silent negative, would keep this correct without reaching back into `@cline/llms`.

Same failure mode, different consequence. This replaced `getProviderCollectionSync(...).provider.capabilities` with `config.providerAuth`, so when that's missing or doesn't match `config.provider` the capability check is skipped entirely. A catalog-declared OAuth or local-auth provider outside the hard-coded `OAUTH_MANAGED_PROVIDERS` set then falls through to the missing-API-key path and gets reported as missing a key it never reads.

discussion_comments.comment_body: Added in 3fe2f2a: `sqlite-cron-store.bun-test.ts` runs under `bun test` (the Desktop runtime, bun:sqlite) and (1) asserts bun:sqlite binds named parameters by exact token — unprefixed keys bind NULL, prefixed keys bind the value; (2) end-to-end: claimDueRuns claims a due one-off run (status=running). Fixed. The matcher now accepts `false`, `False`, and `FALSE`, the three spellings both js-yaml's JSON schema and the SDK's yaml parser read as boolean false (`no`/`off` stay strings in both, so they are correctly left alone). Test added.

Fixed in 39f1a1cd0. With Cloud selected the webview always sends a cloud request, `newTask` refuses a cloud request that has no repository instead of starting locally, and the composer disables send until a repository is chosen. Verified against the local cloud fixture with `CLINE_LOCAL_CLOUD_NO_REPOSITORIES=1`.
